question: When is Indian Army Day celebrated every year?
solution:
The correct answer is __15 January.____ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• Indian Army Day or Army Day is observed across the country on January 15__ to celebrate the glorious history and salute the valiant soldiers and jawans of the Indian Army.
 
• On January 15 in 1949, General KM Cariappa took over the charge of the Indian Army from British General Sir Francis Butcher and the day is celebrated as Army day.
 
• Field Marshal** KM Cariappa** became the first Indian Army Chief of independent India.
